title: Business law, ethics and financial regulation
audience: a college student in a finance, accounting or business degree program, or a career changer studying the same material on their own
purpose: Explain contracts, agency, business organizations and securities law; describe how the SEC, FINRA, the Federal Reserve and other regulators supervise markets and firms; apply rules on disclosure, insider trading, market manipulation and anti-money laundering; and reason through ethical dilemmas in finance.

weeks.4: Regulators: SEC, FINRA, CFTC and banking agencies
weeks.7: Investment advisers, broker-dealers and fiduciary duty

blocks.deliverable: Map who regulates five kinds of firms.
Week 7 midterm; compare a fiduciary and a suitability standard.
Write a resolution to an ethical dilemma.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Compliance memo: analyze a described enforcement case, identify the laws and rules broken, explain the regulators' actions, and write a four-page memo recommending controls and ethical practices to prevent a repeat.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
